task.description:
Run the test suite for DSL-01 and produce a structured test report at tests/reports/report-<timestamp>-WF02-dsl01-step04.json.

Steps:
1. Run: zig build test-expr (the dedicated expr module test step)
2. If test-expr is not available, run: zig build test
3. For each test case in tests/specs/DSL-01.md, verify pass/fail against the actual parser output by exercising the public API in src/expr/mod.zig
4. Write a test report to tests/reports/ following the format in docs/guides/test_developer_guide.md §8

The report must record for each test case:
- TC id (e.g. TC-DSL01-001)
- Input expression
- Expected outcome (PASS/FAIL with expected error fields)
- Actual outcome
- Status: PASS or FAIL
- For failures: actual ParseError line, column, token, message vs. expected

Acceptance criteria:
- All 56 test cases in tests/specs/DSL-01.md exercised
- Zero BLOCKER or MAJOR issues
- Report written to tests/reports/
- zig build test exits 0
